summary: Useful variants preserve feature ownership while acknowledging shared infrastructure and enforcing the intended boundaries.

items.text: Use a hybrid tree: product features own vertical slices, while a small platform area owns deliberately shared runtime, design-system, and observability capabilities.
Generate or test an ownership manifest that maps each feature folder to maintainers, public entry points, and allowed dependencies.
Use co-change history to suggest misplaced files or emerging feature boundaries, but require human review before moving code because co-change can also reflect temporary migrations.
Expose one narrow package entry point per feature and keep implementation files private, combining locality with an enforceable public surface.
